adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a bug in the totalPages calculation. When user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g., 50 users with limit 50), the formula `Math.floor(50/50) + 1 = 2` returns 2 pages when there should only be 1. The correct formula should be `Math.ceil(user_count / limit)`. This would cause the 'Next' button to remain enabled when on the last page, allowing navigation to an empty page.
